verdict.rationale: New Relic publishes self-serve pricing with a perpetual free tier and 100 GB/month of free ingest. Community reports confirm extra ingest is billed at a standard rate, so costs can be estimated without contacting sales. However, the evidence shows ingest- and user-based pricing rather than per-signal rates, and users report hard-to-predict bills: default-on log collection and JFR multiplied ingest, the free tier was quickly exceeded, and non-prod environments were billed at full rates. Missing for 10: published per-signal (metrics/logs/traces) price breakdown, actual per-GB/per-user rate figures in evidence, cost-estimation tooling, independent confirmation that bills are predictable.
